description: This file defines the OrganizationPermissionService class and related permission-checking methods for organization management, including permission validation, onboarding status, and team migration checks.

classes.name: OrganizationPermissionService
classes.description: A service class providing permission checks related to organization creation, modification, onboarding, and team migration.

methods.name: hasPermissionToCreateForEmail
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to create an organization for the specified email.

methods.name: hasConflictingOrganization
methods.description: Checks if an organization with the given slug already exists.

methods.name: hasCompletedOnboarding
methods.description: Checks if onboarding has been completed for the given email.

methods.name: hasPermissionToModifyDefaultPayment
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to modify default payment settings.

methods.name: hasModifiedDefaultPayment
methods.description: Determines if the default payment settings have been modified.

methods.name: hasPermissionToMigrateTeams
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to migrate specified teams.

methods.name: validatePermissions
methods.description: Validates various permissions for organization creation, onboarding, and team migration based on input parameters.
